nonconformity: invalid check character (expected A); not in ENTSO-E's central registry
explanation: Elexon publishes it as the biddingZone of some REMIT messages: for interconnectors (Moyle, East-West) and for GB units (e.g. Drax, Cruachan, Marchwood) whose other messages carry 10YGB----------A. Its prefix 10 names ENTSO-E as the issuing office, which registers every code it issues, and a local code must still have a valid check character (EIC Reference Manual 5.5, sections 3.2.4 and 5.3), so no issuing office allocated it. Elexon's REMIT documentation does not define it. Read as the GB bidding zone.
